narrationTexts: Fix `options.js` to read `retryCount`, and default `isBackoffEnabled` to `false` when unset.
finalText:
**Build is clean now.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

The bump changed two shapes and two call sites weren't updated:

- [options.js](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Threw on `.toFixed` since it was `undefined`.
- [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`, since the new loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`.

Fixed both. The rest was deprecation noise, safe to leave.

Next: nothing.
